context:
Goal: a session never leaves a stray branch on origin by pushing to the wrong name.
Problem (risk): banchi's own hook asks on this push, but the shared push guard lets every unforced push through, so other repos have no guard against it.
Based on (incident): banchi 2026-09-12, a stray branch on origin (plan, banchi row 5).
Based on (read): hooks/guard_push_delete.py push_verdict returns '' for any push that is not forced or deleting (main da8d8073).
Based on (notes): the plan read the gap from code and did not run it; the lane confirms the case first.
Departs from: shared push guard, which allows any unforced push — it asks when HEAD goes to a name other than the upstream.

lastAnswer.note: Owner pick a, 22:23 CST. Lane push-guard-asks builds it (coordinator 22:24 CST).

options.gain: Every repo gets the guard banchi earned from its incident.
options.how: Lane push-head-upstream-name adds the ask to the shared push guard after it confirms the case; banchi then removes its clause_push.
options.label: Promote to the shared guard
options.lose: One more ask when a session pushes HEAD to a new name on purpose.

options.gain: No change to the shared guard.
options.how: Drop the lane; banchi keeps clause_push.
options.label: Keep it in banchi only
options.lose: Other repos can still leave stray branches.

ref: docs/plans/child-guard-promotion.md on PR #1119 (ea66d8e), owner question 4, banchi row 5; step push-head-upstream-name
title: Should the shared push guard ask when git push origin HEAD lands on a branch other than the upstream?
why: The incident is real and the mistake is not banchi-specific.
